verdict.rationale: Check's own docs say its embeddable Components can 'set up third-party integrations such as Quickbooks Online', which points to a first-party accounting integration. Nothing in the evidence describes what that integration does: no documentation that payroll journal entries are mapped or synced automatically, and no mention of Xero. missing for 10: documented automatic journal-entry sync, GL/account mapping details, Xero support, sync frequency/trigger behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can sync payroll journal entries automatically to my accounting software like QuickBooks or Xero

citations.quote: over 30 Components, which allow you to easily onboard employees, run payroll, generate reports, and set up third-party integrations such as Quickbooks Online.
